Find the newest datetime in each table

Source: R/inventory.R
db_freshness.Rd

For every table with at least one date or datetime column, runs one query taking MAX() of each such column and records the overall newest value and the column that held it. This is the freshness signal of the inventory.

Usage

db_freshness(
  con,
  tables = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  dialect = NULL,
  progress = interactive()
)

Arguments

con

A DBIConnection.

tables

A table list as returned by db_tables(). Defaults to every table visible on the connection.

columns

A column list from db_columns(); computed if NULL.

dialect

Optional dialect override, see db_dialect().

progress

Show a progress bar? Default TRUE in interactive use.

Value

tables with newest_datetime, newest_datetime_column and n_datetime_columns added. newest_datetime is ISO 8601 text as the engine rendered it, so that date-only and sub-second types coexist.
